study: V1 contact-policy robustness follow-up; not a test of the new humanoid visual rig
development_distribution: Equal low/high friction-and-mass mixture using seed parity
heldout_distribution: Same registered mixture on fresh disjoint seeds
stress_distribution: High friction and mass only, fresh disjoint seeds
control: 32 random candidates drawn uniformly from the same four policy families
selection: development success count, then lower mean final distance; deterministic veto on non-improvement
claims: No new neural weights, no causal no-memory/no-search ablation; new held-out outcomes assessed only after freeze
